projection: occupied if any supported voxel; free only if every vertical bin has >= minimum_free_frames and zero hits; otherwise unknown
ray_origin_approximation: one LiDAR origin at each scan reference time; registered/undistorted endpoints; not exact instantaneous per-beam origins

floor.method: Seeded near-horizontal RANSAC followed by SVD; global flat-floor candidate

limits: Static-map candidate; not navigation or collision-clearance acceptance
Uncalibrated candidate external parameters and point-time interpretation inherited from FAST-LIO run
Global flat-floor model; no slope/step/drop-off handling
Below/above configured height band not covered
No interpolation, hole filling, trajectory carving or unknown-to-free conversion
No real robot command or localization deployment
